headline: Ghana Banking Industry Steps Up Anti-Fraud Awareness Campaigns
summary: Ghana's banking industry is stepping up anti-fraud education as social engineering scams present increasing cyber security and financial risks.
why: Rising retail fraud and cyber scams threaten consumer confidence and credit institution margins in developing digital finance ecosystems.

impacts.name: Ghana Banking Sector
impacts.why: Lenders in Ghana are escalating anti-fraud education campaigns to mitigate mounting financial cyber risks.
